booking_policy: By Appointment First — Zero Upfront Payment Gate
cleanliness_standard: Clean floor drop cloths laid under every indoor unit; zero wall or floor mess
permitting_disclaimer: Affordable Home A/C focuses on specialty mechanical refrigeration craftsmanship. Homeowners or general contractors coordinate City & County of Honolulu DPP municipal building permits independently if mandated by condo boards or HOAs.

services.name: New Installation & Replacement Consultation
services.scope: Comprehensive room-by-room cooling load analysis, power requirement review, equipment selection, and itemized estimate. Zero upfront fee.

services.name: Diagnostic Troubleshooting & Symptom Isolation
services.scope: In-depth electrical continuity check, electronic halogen sniffer leak detection, thermistor resistance testing, and inverter board diagnostics.

services.name: Basic Mini-Split Cleaning & Coil Sanitize
services.scope: Casing wipe-down, mesh filter chemical wash, high-velocity coil foaming wash, and condensate tray rinse. Drop cloths on floor.

services.name: Premium Deep Teardown Cleaning
services.scope: Front housing unclipped, blower wheel cylinder completely extracted for 360-degree degreasing bath, coil scrub, drain pan sanitization. Protective floor drop cloths under unit. Zero messy hydro bags.

services.name: Condensate Drain Line Clearing & Flush
services.scope: Commercial vacuum line evacuation, thorough water flush to clear algae biofilm plugs, and anti-fungal pan tablet placement. Professional vacuum extraction only — no high-pressure nitrogen gas.

services.name: Waipahu Warehouse Direct Inventory Sales
services.scope: Brand-new factory-sealed LG Dual Inverter ($560 to $1,025), LG Standard ($395 to $895), and GE Built-In ($1,000 to $1,200) units in stock at 94-150 Leoleo St #203. Same-day local pickup available.

services.name: Hawaii Energy Cash Rebate
services.scope: Instant or mail-in cash rebate for Oahu residential electric customers purchasing qualifying Energy Star window AC models only.

services.name: Island-Wide Flat Rate Delivery
services.scope: Delivery to residential or commercial addresses across eligible Oahu service zones (Central Oahu, Metro Honolulu, Leeward Kapolei/Ewa Beach, and Windward Kailua/Kaneohe) for $50 flat rate.

services.name: Standard Window AC Installation
services.scope: Custom fabrication for jalousie glass, vertical horizontal slider filler panel, or double-hung window. Weatherproof marine foam sealing, floor drop cloth protection, laser leveling. Standard exterior sill support brackets optional.

services.name: Clean vs. Replace Evaluation
services.scope: Guidance on DIY filter maintenance for newer quality window units vs upgrading to energy-efficient Dual Inverters ($560–$1,025) or GE Built-In ($1,000–$1,200) units for aged units with corroded coils or failing compressors. Zero off-site shop teardowns.
